request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: We evaluate the regional screening programme and need prevalence figures by region and age band.
request.question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes in each region and what is the prevalence?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Prevalence = adults with type 2 diabetes / all adults in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: adults, adults with type 2 diabetes and the prevalence.
